en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a tall clock tower with a pointed roof and large clock faces on its walls. The tower stands on a hill overlooking a cityscape, with a winding path leading to it. There are a few people walking along the path, and trees and greenery are visible on the left side. The words 'GRAZ' and 'Uhrturm' are printed in red text at the top.
